definitions.full: H4327. min [ מִין ] noun [masculine] kind, species (Late Hebrew id. (Ecclus 43:25 id. ), also schismatic, heretic ; Jewish-Aramaic מִינָא , species ; Palestinian Syriac = nation PS 2094 Schw Idioticon 50 ; yet not Aramaic loan-word in Hebrew; see Lag BN 183 f. ); — always suffix + preposition לְמִינֵהוּ Gen 1:12 (twice in verse) + 2t.; לְמִינוֺ 1:11 (omitted by ᵐ5 ) + 3 t.; לְמִינָהּ 1:24 (twice in verse) + 9 t.; לְמִינָהֿ Ezek 47:10 (strike out Co); לְמִינֵהֶם Gen 1:21 ; — kind, species , of plant 1:11-12 , (twice in verse); usually of animal (beast, bird, fish, insect) 1:21-22 , 24 (twice in verse); 1:25 (3 t. in verse); 6:20 (3 t. in verse); 7:14 (4 t. in verse); Lev 11:14-15 , 16 , 19 , 22 (4 t. in verse); 11:29 (all P); also Deut 14:13-14 , 15 , 18 (compare Leviticus) Ezek 47:10 (on text, compare Co).
